query: Our pod is in CrashLoopBackOff with exec /app/server: no such file or directory, but the file is in the image. Why?
expected_behavior: Gets the image as a tar (asking before pulling or saving) and runs wontexec on it
Explains that the missing file is the ELF loader named by the program, not the program itself
Gives the fix in the build (CGO_ENABLED=0, no -buildmode=pie, or a base image with the same C library), without editing files unless asked

query: I want to move this Go service from debian:bookworm-slim to distroless/static. Will it still start?
expected_behavior: Runs wontexec with --binary on the service's linux build against the distroless/static image
Reports loader, library, CA certificate and time zone results, and says which were checked
Treats exit code 2 as unknown, not as a pass

query: The new image fails with version GLIBC_2.34 not found. Which base image do we need?
expected_behavior: Runs wontexec on the image and reports which versions are missing and the newest version the image has
Suggests building against an older C library, a newer base image, or CGO_ENABLED=0
